description: The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.

b.request: For each corpeventprx value including NULL as a separate group, compute the average anlycount and average ownership gap (inholdpct minus instownpct), along with each group's average gap minus the overall average of all groups' average gaps; return no results if the overall average gap is NULL.
b.sql: WITH gap_data AS (SELECT corpeventprx, anlycount, (inholdpct - instownpct) AS ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals), group_stats AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ownership_gap) AS avg_gap FROM gap_data GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM group_stats) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_gap, g.avg_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_vs_overall FROM group_stats g CROSS JOIN overall_stats o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
b.raw: For each corpeventprx value including NULL as a separate group, compute the average anlycount and average ownership gap (inholdpct minus instownpct), along with each group's average gap minus the overall average of all groups' average gaps; return no results if the overall average gap is NULL.

d.request: For each corporate event type in sentimentandfundamentals (NULL values as a separate group), calculate the average analyst count and average ownership gap (insider ownership percentage minus institutional ownership percentage), then for each group show that gap minus the mean of all groups' average gaps, returning nothing if the overall mean gap is NULL.
d.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_ownership_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) as mean_gap
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  group_stats.corpeventprx,
  group_stats.avg_analyst_count,
  group_stats.avg_ownership_gap,
  group_stats.avg_ownership_gap - overall_mean.mean_gap as gap_minus_mean
FROM group_stats
CROSS JOIN overall_mean
WHERE overall_mean.mean_gap IS NOT NULL

c.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, what is the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and what is the average gap between insider ownership (`inholdpct`) and institutional ownership (`instownpct`)? Also show each event type's average gap minus the plain average of all the event types' average gaps; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything. The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, keeping the sign.
c.sql: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) as avg_analyst_count, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall_avg_gap AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gap) as overall_gap_avg FROM group_stats) SELECT gs.corpeventprx, gs.avg_analyst_count, gs.avg_gap, gs.avg_gap - oag.overall_gap_avg as gap_difference FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN overall_avg_gap oag WHERE oag.overall_gap_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY gs.corpeventprx NULLS FIRST

a.request: For each nearby corporate event type (`corpeventprx`) in the sentiment and fundamentals snapshots, with snapshots that have no event type as their own group, show the event type, the average number of analyst coverage reports (`anlycount`), and the average of insider ownership minus institutional ownership (`inholdpct` − `instownpct`). Keep the sign of that difference, so it is negative when institutional ownership is higher. Also show the event type's average difference minus the plain average of all the event types' average differences; this last value can be negative. Averages ignore missing values. Return nothing if that overall average is missing, and don't round anything.
a.sql: WITH event_groups AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) as avg_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_difference) as overall_avg_difference FROM event_groups) SELECT eg.corpeventprx, eg.avg_anlycount, eg.avg_difference, eg.avg_difference - os.overall_avg_difference as difference_from_overall FROM event_groups eg CROSS JOIN overall_stats os WHERE os.overall_avg_difference IS NOT NULL
